notes: Empty or missing carried objects reach C's lookup failure and exact missing-object bytes; compare is not skill-gated.
Resolving the same carried object twice uses C's same-object refusal.
A weapon and a non-weapon object use C's type-mismatch refusal.
Two carried weapons exercise the C value arithmetic, percent/noise draw, result thresholds, capitalization, and byte output across seeds.
Two same-slot body armors exercise the C armor value arithmetic, percent/noise draw, result thresholds, capitalization, and byte output across seeds.
Two armor objects with different wear slots use C's same-type-of-armor refusal before RNG.
Two distinct same-type non-armor objects reach C's weapons-and-armor-only refusal.
The blindness early return is checked before carried-object resolution and preserves C's exact message.
An active FIGHTING pointer takes C's busy refusal even when object lookup also fails.
